messages:
sam: Heads up — I'm flying into SFO early Monday (6:30a pickup). Anyone know if hotel breakfast near Mission St is worth it or should I hunt down empanadas on the way? Need something quick and >garbage-free. 😅
rina: If you're by Market/Mission, the hotel breakfast is fine but usually slow before 7. Empanada cart on 3rd & Market opens at 6:15 most days — solid and fast.
jose: Empanada cart is 🔥. Cash only though. If you need card, Blue Bottle at Embarcadero opens at 6:30, good coffee + pastries.
katie: @sam fwiw the Uber time from SFO to downtown at 6am can be 25-40m depending on traffic, so plan accordingly. I usually do a pre-order grab from the hotel and bring to the office.
sam: Good point re: timing. Does the cart have veggie options?
rina: Yes! Spinach+cheese and mushroom (ask for extra salsa).
alan: If anyone else is traveling, FYI: hotel buffet costs ~$18 and includes eggs, fruit. Not terrible but slower. :thumbsup:
taylor: major second for empanada cart. Also there's a hole-in-the-wall spot on Mission & 5th with empanadas you can phone ahead to pick up.
deploy-bot: Reminder: office kitchen restock tomorrow 8am — coffee and croissants arriving. :coffee:
sam: Perfect — I'll aim for the cart or Blue Bottle depending on traffic. Thanks y'all! :pray:
